rationale: Price is sitting at 91% of today's range with only 55 minutes to close, trading just below the 9-EMA ($59.07) and within $0.43 of the session high ($59.38), suggesting upside is limited and the stock has already absorbed most of the gap-up move. The last five 1-minute candles show a mild drift lower with increasing volume on down-moves, indicating distribution near the highs rather than continuation. The fundamental backdrop (massive goodwill charge, shrinking margins, transformation costs excluded from adjusted earnings) creates asymmetric risk for a long, while the stock is already up ~14% from prior close making a short against strong momentum equally unattractive with limited time remaining.
